'''Balam''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] figure in the [[Gungan religion|religion]] of the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Species/Legends|species]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. According to legend, Balam was the first Gungan [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]], and upon his [[Death/Legends|death]] he was taken by [[Oma-Oma]], the chief of the Gungan [[Gud/Legends|guds]], to the [[Water/Legends|underwater]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ossorus]]. Oma-Oma granted Balam [[Immortality/Legends|immortality]] and turned him into the god of battles so that he could teach the other [[Deity/Legends|guds]] the art of war.<ref name="SWGB" />

Balam went on to create the hidden paradise [[Otoh-D'in]] in the [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of Naboo. There, the bravest Gungan [[Militiagung/Legends|militiagungs]] would arrive after their deaths and spend eternity distracting themselves with combat and strategy games. If Ossorus ever came under attack, the warriors of Otoh-D'in would defend it.<ref name="SWGB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Balam was mentioned in the [[Wikipedia:French language|French]] edition of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'' in the Gungan DataBank entry.<ref name="SWGB" />
